mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_task_trigger (id, org_id, project_id, name, trigger_type, cron_expression, timezone, event_type, event_filter, webhook_secret_cipher, concurrency_policy, missed_policy, task_template, enabled, next_fire_at, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, version) VALUES (#{id}, #{organizationId}, #{projectId}, #{name}, #{triggerType}, #{cronExpression}, #{timezone}, #{eventType}, #{eventFilter}, #{webhookSecretCipher}, #{concurrencyPolicy}, #{missedPolicy}, #{taskTemplate}, #{enabled}, #{nextFireAt}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_task_trigger WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_task_trigger SET name=#{name}, trigger_type=#{triggerType}, cron_expression=#{cronExpression}, timezone=#{timezone}, event_type=#{eventType}, event_filter=#{eventFilter}, webhook_secret_cipher=COALESCE(#{webhookSecretCipher}, webhook_secret_cipher), concurrency_policy=#{concurrencyPolicy}, missed_policy=#{missedPolicy}, task_template=#{taskTemplate}, enabled=#{enabled}, next_fire_at=#{nextFireAt}, updated_by=#{updatedBy}, updated_at=#{updatedAt}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}

UPDATE ai_task_trigger SET next_fire_at=#{nextFireAt}, updated_at=#{updatedAt}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND enabled=1 AND trigger_type='CRON' AND next_fire_at=#{scheduledAt}
UPDATE ai_task_trigger SET last_fire_at=#{fireAt}, last_fire_status=#{status}, last_error=#{error}, updated_at=#{fireAt} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_execution_task WHERE source = CONCAT('TRIGGER:', #{triggerId}) AND status NOT IN ('SUCCESS','PARTIAL_SUCCESS','FAILED','CANCELED','EXPIRED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_task_trigger_history (id, trigger_id, task_id, event_id, scheduled_at, fire_time, status, message, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{triggerId}, #{taskId}, #{eventId}, #{scheduledAt}, #{fireTime}, #{status}, #{message}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_task_trigger_history WHERE trigger_id=#{triggerId} ORDER BY fire_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM ai_task_trigger_history WHERE trigger_id=#{triggerId} AND event_id=#{eventId}
